Rules: Emperor Edition core rules; curated Effect/Ability IDs, never inferred from prose.

Cards.Name: Palace of the Breaking Dawn
Cards.Text:
Your Ronin cards enter play paying 1 less Gold and ignoring Honor Requirements.
Battle: Even if this card is bowed, choose your performing opposed Ronin Personality: Give him +2F.

Cards.Name: Pillars of Virtue
Cards.Text: Reaction: After the resolution of a Kiho Battle action you took: Take an additional Battle action.

Cards.Name: Shiro Chugo
Cards.Text:
Political Reaction: Before an action's resolution, choose your performing unbowed Courtier: Reduce any Honor gain or loss from the action's effects by 2.
Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Personality: Melee 4 Attack, with +1 strength if he is Loyal.

Cards.Name: Steel Soul Dojo
Cards.Text:
You do not lose Honor from Spider Clan and Fate cards you own.
After the resolution of the first Dark Virtue action you took each phase: Draw a card.

Cards.Name: Suitengu's Torch
Cards.Text:
Reaction: After you announce a Thunder Battle action: Its effects will not be negated or delayed.
Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Personality and target an enemy Personality: Move him home.

Cards.Name: Temple of Purity
Cards.Text: Open: Even if this card is bowed, target another player's Personality: Give him -4F, which will not be negated. If he is Kolat, Ninja, or Shadowlands, you control an Inquisitor, and it is not your turn, choose a player, who gains or loses 2 Honor.

Cards.Name: The Aerie
Cards.Text: Iaijutsu Battle: Even if this card is bowed, choose your performing unbowed Samurai and target another player's Personality: Your Samurai duels the Personality. Bow and dishonor the duel's loser. The winner's controller gains 1 Honor.

Cards.Name: The Golden Plains
Cards.Text: Recon Reaction: After engaging: You have Reconnaissance at the current battlefield. Create a Terrain Strategy with the ability, "Battle: If this card is in play, destroy it and target a Terrain in your hand: Take an additional Battle action to play it." Put it into play there.

Cards.Name: Plain of Gold
Cards.Text:
May not be included in decks.
Battle: If this card is in play, destroy it and target a Terrain in your hand: Take an additional Battle action to play it.
